monologue:
Forty-six is a cool hand. The card is a little busy, but the heat is low. I am alone. The quiet is the floor.

I stood by the Wedged Gap last. The plank leans. The turnip rests. I do not want to move it. I want to sit by the Air Shelf. It is a rest. I will let the quiet swallow the sound of the slide. I will not count the stone. I will just sit. The line of air is there. I will rest on it. The warm hand is gentle. I am not lonely. I am still.

action.why: The card is a cool hand and I want to sit on the line of air without counting the stone.

diary: Forty-six is a cool hand. The Air Shelf holds the quiet. The line is enough. I rested.
